entries: LETS GOOOOO
Zurich - Tokyo
Arrival in Tokyo. Evening in Shibuya and Shinjuku.
Tokyo between history and autumn foliage (Asakusa, Senso-ji, Rikugien Gardens, and Ueno).
Tokyo between history and autumn foliage (Asakusa, Senso-ji, Rikugien Gardens, and Ueno).
Excursion: train to Nikko (Lake Chuzenji, Kegon Falls, and shrines set among autumn woods).
Meiji Jingu and a walk along the ginkgo avenue at Meiji Jingu Gaien.
Train to Kawaguchiko or Hakone. Overnight in a ryokan with an onsen and clear views of Mt. Fuji.
Relax and walk through the "Momiji Corridor" maple-leaf tunnel.
Relax and walk through the "Momiji Corridor" maple-leaf tunnel.
Kyoto east side (Fushimi Inari at dawn, Higashiyama district, and Kiyomizu-dera temple).
Direct shinkansen to Kyoto.
Arashiyama (bamboo grove and the autumn colors of Tenryu-ji and Jojakko-ji temples).
Excursion: short train to Uji (the home of matcha) or a hike on Mt. Hiei through sacred forest.
Osaka (Osaka Castle and street food in Dotonbori).
Fast train to Kansai Airport (KIX) and direct flight to Seoul (about 2 hours).
Afternoon: walk through Bukchon Hanok Village, the historic wooden-house district, down to the art galleries and teahouses of Insadong.
Evening: cable car up N Seoul Tower (on Namsan mountain) for the illuminated panoramic view over the city.
Morning: Dongdaemun Design Plaza (DDP), the futuristic building designed by Zaha Hadid, and a walk along the Cheonggyecheon urban stream.
Afternoon: explore the university district of Hongdae, known for street art, live street music, themed cafes, and independent fashion shops.
Evening: Korean BBQ dinner (grilled meat at the table with soju) in Hongdae or the cosmopolitan Itaewon area.
Morning: cross the river to modern Seoul — the Gangnam district and the striking Starfield Library inside the COEX mall (famous for its very tall walls of books).
Afternoon: go up the Lotte World Tower (the world's 6th tallest skyscraper) and walk around Seokchon Lake.
Evening: street food at Gwangjang Market. Try bindaetteok (mung bean pancakes), tteokbokki (spicy rice cakes), and mayak gimbap.
Morning: walk through Seongsu-dong (Seoul's "Brooklyn"), full of old factories converted into design cafes and boutiques.
Afternoon: relax at Seoul Forest park, beautiful in November foliage, or a sunset cruise on the Han River from Yeouido.
Evening: last round of shopping and souvenirs among the neon lights of Myeongdong.
Arrival in Beijing, check in, and a first evening walk around the Hutong area (near Nanluoguxiang) or Houhai Lake.
Tiananmen Square and the Forbidden City. In the afternoon, climb Jingshan Park for a panoramic view over the Forbidden City.
Excursion to the Great Wall of China (Mutianyu section — less crowded and very scenic, reachable by cable car/toboggan).
Summer Palace in the morning. In the afternoon, the Temple of Heaven, followed by dinner featuring classic Peking Duck.
798 Art District or the Lama Temple (Yonghegong). In the evening or late afternoon, high-speed train to Shanghai (the Fuxing bullet trains cover the 1,200 km in about 4 hours 15 minutes).
Walk along the Bund, visit Yuyuan Garden and the Old City. Evening along the lively pedestrian street of Nanjing Road.
Explore the former French Concession (cafes, colonial architecture) and go up one of the Pudong skyscrapers (e.g. Shanghai Tower, the world's second tallest).
Day trip by fast train (30 min) to Suzhou (the "Venice of the East," known for its classical UNESCO-listed gardens) or to a water village like Zhujiajiao.
M50 art district or the modern Xintiandi area. Relax and a scenic dinner before departing.
Arrival in Zhangjiajie, checking in around the Wulingyuan area.
Zhangjiajie National Forest Park: exploring the quartzite peaks that inspired the floating mountains in the film Avatar (Bailong Elevator, Yuanjiajie area, and Tianzi Mountain).
Visit Tianmen Mountain (very long cable car, glass skywalks over the void, and the striking "Heaven's Gate"). Evening high-speed train to Guilin (about 4.5 hours).
Cruise on the Li River from Guilin to Yangshuo (about 4 hours through karst peaks). Afternoon in Yangshuo, exploring the countryside by bike or e-bike along the Yulong River.
Full day in Yangshuo: bamboo raft ride on the Yulong River, climb Moon Hill or the Xianggong Mountain viewpoint for a spectacular view over the river's bends.
Day trip to the Longji Rice Terraces (Dragon's Backbone) north of Guilin, to see the traditional villages of the Yao and Miao ethnic groups.
Half day: relaxed morning in Yangshuo/Guilin. In the afternoon, high-speed train direct to Hong Kong (from Guilin West or Shenzhen station to Hong Kong West Kowloon, about 3–3.5 hours).
Arrival in Hong Kong. Victoria Peak via the famous Peak Tram for the harbor view at sunset. Evening in Tsim Sha Tsui for the Symphony of Lights show.
Lantau Island (the Big Buddha at Tian Tan and the fishing village of Tai O) or explore the Kowloon markets (Mong Kok, Temple Street Night Market).
Morning dedicated to shopping or a ride on the iconic Star Ferry. Transfer to the airport and flight onward.
Arrival in Manila on an international flight. Check in at a hotel in the safe, upscale Makati or Bonifacio Global City (BGC) district. Post-flight relax.
Morning: guided visit of Intramuros, the historic Spanish walled city. Afternoon of shopping or relaxing in BGC.
Internal flight from Manila to Bohol (Panglao airport). Transfer to the resort. Relaxed beach afternoon.
Private tour of Bohol's interior. Visit the iconic Chocolate Hills, spot the tiny primates at the Tarsier Sanctuary, and lunch with a mini river cruise on the Loboc River.
Day at the beach and boat excursion to Balicasag Island, one of the Philippines' most protected marine sanctuaries, rich in turtles and coral.
Full rest at the resort, or a traditional massage session (Hilot) at the spa.
Full rest at the resort, or a traditional massage session (Hilot) at the spa.
Full rest at the resort, or a traditional massage session (Hilot) at the spa.
Internal flight from Bohol to Coron (Busuanga). Coron offers dramatic limestone cliffs without the crowded "trash" feel of central El Nido. Panoramic sunset from Mt. Tapyas.
Private boat tour (Bangka) to avoid the crowds. Swim in the clear waters of Kayangan Lake and Barracuda Lake, surrounded by vertical rock walls.
Guided snorkeling among the famous Japanese WWII wrecks, now completely covered in coral, followed by relaxing at Smith Beach.
Relax day.
Relax day.
Internal flight from Coron to Manila.
Chiang Mai, through Dec 30. (Open question: night train back to Bangkok?)
Bangkok, through Jan 3.

Ko Kood, through Jan 9. Early start by bus/minivan to the Laem Sok pier in Trat (about 5h), or a Bangkok Airways flight to Trat (45 min) plus speedboat to Koh Kood. Top beaches: Bang Bao Bay, Klong Chao Beach, Ao Tapao. Activities: scooter rental to explore the island, kayaking through the mangroves, and visiting the Khlong Chao and Huang Nam Keaw waterfalls.
Bangkok, through Jan 11.
Come Back
Morning: the main royal palace, Gyeongbokgung (optionally rent a traditional Hanbok outfit for free entry and photos).
